scenarios.title: Verify Insights View Navigation for Functional Tests
scenarios.description: Ensure users can access the Insights view for Functional tests in the Playwright dashboard
scenarios.testDescription: Verify that users can navigate to and view the Insights section specifically for Functional tests in the Playwright UI
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright testing framework is properly installed and configured
2. User has access to the Playwright dashboard
3. Some functional tests have already been executed and their results are available
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Log in to the Playwright dashboard
2. Navigate to the test results section
3. Locate and click on the 'Insights' tab or button
4. Select or filter for 'Functional Tests' category
scenarios.expectedResult: The Insights view for Functional tests should load successfully, displaying relevant metrics and data visualizations specific to functional tests

scenarios.title: Verify Functional Test Data Display in Insights View
scenarios.description: Ensure that functional test data is correctly displayed in the Insights view
scenarios.testDescription: Verify that all relevant metrics and data related to functional tests are correctly displayed in the Insights view
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright testing framework is properly installed and configured
2. Multiple functional tests have been executed with varied results (passed, failed, flaky)
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Access the Playwright dashboard
2. Navigate to the Insights view for Functional tests
3. Check for the presence of relevant metrics such as pass/fail rates, test duration, flaky tests, etc.
4. Verify that the data corresponds to the actual functional test results
scenarios.expectedResult: The Insights view should display accurate and comprehensive data about the functional tests, including metrics like pass/fail rates, test duration, and any flaky tests

scenarios.title: Filter Functionality in Functional Test Insights
scenarios.description: Verify the filter options work correctly in the Functional test Insights view
scenarios.testDescription: Test the functionality of different filter options available in the Functional test Insights view
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright dashboard is accessible
2. Functional test Insights view is implemented
3. Multiple functional tests with different statuses have been executed
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Access the Functional test Insights view
2. Identify available filter options (e.g., by test status, by test duration, by test name)
3. Apply each filter option one by one
4. For each filter, verify that the displayed results match the filter criteria
scenarios.expectedResult: Each filter should correctly narrow down the displayed test results according to the selected criteria. The UI should update dynamically to reflect the filtered data.

scenarios.title: Comparison Between Different Test Types in Insights
scenarios.description: Verify users can compare metrics between Functional tests and other test types
scenarios.testDescription: Test the ability to compare metrics between Functional tests and previously implemented test types (Unit, Integration, and API tests)
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Insights view is implemented for all test types (Unit, Integration, API, and Functional)
2. Tests of each type have been executed and have available results
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Access the Playwright Insights dashboard
2. Navigate to a comparison view or enable comparison functionality if available
3. Select metrics to compare between Functional tests and other test types
4. Observe the comparative visualization or data
scenarios.expectedResult: The system should display a clear comparison between metrics from Functional tests and other test types, allowing users to identify patterns, differences, or areas of concern across test categories

scenarios.title: Export Functionality for Functional Test Insights
scenarios.description: Verify the ability to export Functional test insights data
scenarios.testDescription: Test if users can export the Functional test insights data in various formats
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright dashboard with Functional test Insights view is accessible
2. Functional tests have been executed with results available
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional test Insights view
2. Locate and click the export option/button
3. Select different available export formats (e.g., CSV, PDF, JSON)
4. Complete the export process for each format
5. Open each exported file to verify content
scenarios.expectedResult: The system should successfully export the Functional test insights data in each selected format. The exported files should contain accurate and complete data matching what is displayed in the UI.

scenarios.title: Time Period Selection in Functional Test Insights
scenarios.description: Verify the functionality of selecting different time periods for Functional test insights
scenarios.testDescription: Test the ability to view Functional test insights for different time periods
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright dashboard is accessible
2. Functional test results are available for different time periods (e.g., last day, week, month)
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Access the Functional test Insights view
2. Locate the time period selector/filter
3. Select different time periods (e.g., last 24 hours, last 7 days, last 30 days, custom range)
4. For each selection, observe the updated data and visualizations
scenarios.expectedResult: The Insights view should update to display only the functional test data from the selected time period. Historical trends should be visible when longer time periods are selected.

scenarios.title: Detailed View of Individual Functional Test Results
scenarios.description: Verify the ability to drill down into individual functional test results from the Insights view
scenarios.testDescription: Test if users can access detailed information about specific functional tests from the Insights view
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright dashboard with Functional test Insights view is accessible
2. Multiple functional tests have been executed with results available
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Access the Functional test Insights view
2. Identify and click on a specific test or test group
3. Observe the detailed view that appears
4. Check for test steps, screenshots, videos, console logs, and other relevant details
scenarios.expectedResult: Clicking on a specific test should navigate to or display a detailed view showing comprehensive information about that test, including execution details, any captured media, logs, and error messages if applicable.

scenarios.title: Performance of Functional Test Insights View with Large Datasets
scenarios.description: Verify the performance of the Insights view when displaying large volumes of functional test data
scenarios.testDescription: Test the loading time and responsiveness of the Functional test Insights view when dealing with a large number of test results
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright dashboard is accessible
2. A large dataset of functional test results is available (e.g., 1000+ test executions)
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Access the Playwright dashboard
2. Navigate to the Functional test Insights view
3. Measure the time taken for the page to fully load
4. Interact with various elements (filters, dropdowns, charts) and measure response times
5. Try loading increasingly larger datasets if possible
scenarios.expectedResult: The Insights view should load within an acceptable timeframe (under 3 seconds) even with large datasets. Interactions with the UI should remain responsive, with minimal lag when filtering or manipulating the data.

scenarios.title: Cross-Browser Compatibility of Functional Test Insights View
scenarios.description: Verify the Insights view displays correctly across different browsers
scenarios.testDescription: Test if the Functional test Insights view renders correctly and functions properly across multiple browsers
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Access to multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
2. Playwright dashboard with implemented Functional test Insights view
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Open the Playwright dashboard in Chrome
2. Navigate to the Functional test Insights view and verify correct rendering and functionality
3. Repeat steps 1-2 for Firefox, Safari, and Edge browsers
4. Compare the appearance and functionality across all browsers
scenarios.expectedResult: The Functional test Insights view should render consistently across all tested browsers. All features, charts, filters, and interactive elements should function correctly regardless of the browser used.

scenarios.title: Accessibility of Functional Test Insights View
scenarios.description: Verify the accessibility compliance of the Functional test Insights view
scenarios.testDescription: Test if the Functional test Insights view meets accessibility standards and can be used with assistive technologies
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright dashboard with implemented Functional test Insights view
2. Access to accessibility testing tools (e.g., WAVE, axe, screen readers)
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Access the Functional test Insights view
2. Run automated accessibility checks using tools like WAVE or axe
3. Test navigation using keyboard only
4. Test compatibility with screen readers (e.g., NVDA, VoiceOver)
5. Check for appropriate color contrast, text sizes, and element labeling
scenarios.expectedResult: The Functional test Insights view should comply with WCAG 2.1 AA standards. It should be navigable via keyboard, compatible with screen readers, and have appropriate color contrast and element labeling.

scenarios.title: Integration of Functional Test Insights with Existing Test Types
scenarios.description: Verify that Functional test Insights integrate correctly with existing test type insights
scenarios.testDescription: Test if the newly added Functional test Insights integrate properly with the existing insights for Unit, Integration, and API tests
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright dashboard with insights implemented for Unit, Integration, and API tests
2. Functional test Insights have been newly implemented
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Access the Playwright dashboard
2. Navigate through the different test type insights (Unit, Integration, API, and now Functional)
3. Verify consistent navigation patterns and UI elements across all test types
4. Check if switching between test types maintains any applied filters or settings where appropriate
5. Verify any aggregate views that combine metrics across test types
scenarios.expectedResult: The Functional test Insights should follow the same design patterns and navigation flow as the existing test type insights. Switching between test types should be seamless, and any aggregate views should correctly incorporate data from all test types.

scenarios.title: Real-time Updates in Functional Test Insights
scenarios.description: Verify that Functional test Insights update in real-time as tests are executed
scenarios.testDescription: Test if the Functional test Insights view updates dynamically when new functional tests are executed
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright dashboard with Functional test Insights view is accessible
2. Ability to trigger new functional test runs while monitoring the Insights view
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Open the Functional test Insights view
2. Note the current metrics and test results displayed
3. In another session or tab, trigger the execution of new functional tests
4. Observe the Insights view during and after the test execution
scenarios.expectedResult: The Functional test Insights view should update dynamically to include the results of newly executed tests, either automatically or after a manual refresh, depending on the system design. The updates should accurately reflect the new test results.

scenarios.title: Security of Test Data in Functional Test Insights
scenarios.description: Verify the security aspects of displaying functional test data in the Insights view
scenarios.testDescription: Test if the Functional test Insights view properly respects user permissions and secures sensitive test data
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Multiple user accounts with different permission levels
2. Functional tests that include some sensitive data or scenarios
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Log in with an administrator account and access the Functional test Insights
2. Note what data and options are available
3. Log out and log in with a restricted user account
4. Access the Functional test Insights again and compare available data and options
5. Attempt to access sensitive test details or perform restricted actions
scenarios.expectedResult: The Functional test Insights view should enforce proper access controls based on user permissions. Sensitive test data should only be visible to authorized users. Restricted users should not be able to access unauthorized data or perform restricted actions.

scenarios.title: Mobile Responsiveness of Functional Test Insights View
scenarios.description: Verify the responsiveness of the Functional test Insights view on mobile devices
scenarios.testDescription: Test if the Functional test Insights view adapts appropriately to different screen sizes and is usable on mobile devices
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Access to mobile devices or emulators with different screen sizes
2. Playwright dashboard with implemented Functional test Insights view
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Access the Playwright dashboard on a desktop browser and note the layout of the Functional test Insights
2. Access the same view on a tablet device or emulator
3. Access the same view on a smartphone device or emulator
4. Try using all features and functionality on each device
5. Check for any UI issues, text overflow, or unusable elements
scenarios.expectedResult: The Functional test Insights view should be responsive and adapt to different screen sizes. All features should remain accessible and usable on mobile devices, possibly with adapted layouts. No content should be cut off or inaccessible due to screen size limitations.

scenarios.title: User Preferences Persistence in Functional Test Insights
scenarios.description: Verify that user preferences in the Functional test Insights view are saved and persisted
scenarios.testDescription: Test if user preferences such as filters, sort orders, and view settings are saved between sessions
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright dashboard with Functional test Insights view is accessible
2. User account with permission to access and modify Insights views
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Log in to the Playwright dashboard
2. Navigate to the Functional test Insights view
3. Apply specific filters, sorting options, and customize the view
4. Navigate away from the Insights view to another section
5. Return to the Functional test Insights view
6. Log out and log back in
7. Navigate back to the Functional test Insights view
scenarios.expectedResult: The user's preferences (filters, sorting, customizations) should persist when navigating away and returning to the Insights view. These preferences should also persist across different login sessions for the same user.
